podcast.title: Emergence of the Celestial Jukebox (Streaming)
podcast.body: The theoretical concept of a "celestial jukebox" or "infinite jukebox," a place where all music could be universally accessed, has materialized in the form of streaming, providing instant access to at least 50 million songs and continuously growing, a reality that was once considered science fiction. "We in the industry used to talk about something called the celestial jukebox or the infinite jukebox."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Streaming Music Library Scale
podcast.body: Streaming services provide instant access to at least 50 million songs, a number that continually increases each month, representing a massive library of music accessible via an internet connection. "If you have an internet connection, you instantly have access to at least 50 million songs."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
